name: IPinfo
summary: IP geolocation and ASN data: free country-level Lite lookups, and city-level geolocation with hosting, VPN/anonymous, mobile and anycast flags on paid plans.

token.description: an IPinfo access token (ipinfo.io account > Token); free accounts get unlimited Lite lookups

notes: Lite (/lite) is free and unlimited: country, continent and ASN only. Core (/lookup) needs a paid plan and returns city-level geo plus network flags.
Paid plans have a monthly request quota; past it calls return 429 unless metered billing is on. No per-second throttling.
Use 'me' as the IP to look up the caller's own address.

endpoints.name: Look up an IP's country and ASN (Lite)
endpoints.summary: Country, continent, ASN number, name and domain for an IPv4 or IPv6 address. Free.

endpoints.name: Get one Lite field for an IP
endpoints.summary: A single field of the Lite record (asn, as_name, as_domain, country_code, country, continent_code, continent) as plain text.

endpoints.name: Look up an IP's location and network (Core)
endpoints.summary: Hostname, city, region, country, coordinates, time zone, postal code, AS details and is_anonymous, is_hosting, is_mobile, is_anycast, is_satellite flags.
notes: Needs a Core plan or higher; counts against the monthly quota.
